Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_RangeMultiplier:
How far a full battery drives.
1.0 = as far as a full tank in a vanilla car of the same class; 2.0 = twice as far.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_ChargeSpeedMult:
1.0 = official charger power (Wall Connector 11.5 kW, Mobile Connector 7.6 kW)
2.0 = twice as fast.
Sandbox_MinidoracatTesla_CampMinBattery_:
Camp Mode cannot be turned on below this charge and turns off when the battery drops under it.
Like the real car's Low Power Mode: 10–20%%, default 20.
